name: Fan Coil (wall-mounted)
description: A hydronic fan coil - reference Daikin FWT (a room's wall-mounted unit, 2-pipe, 3 fan speeds) and Kampmann TOP (a hall's air heater). Room temperature and humidity, the valve (on / off, remote), fan power and speed. Used by heating-control.

models.name: FWT (wall-mounted fan coil)
models.purpose: A room's heat / cold consumer on the water circuit - a fan blows the room's air over a water coil.

models.name: TOP (air heater for halls)
models.purpose: A hall's heat consumer on the water circuit - wall or ceiling mounted, an axial fan blows the hall's air over a water coil, adjustable louvres direct the jet.
